description: This Java source file defines a helper class 'Log' for logging purposes within an Android project. It provides static methods for different log levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), manages a linked list of LogNode objects for log handling, and encapsulates logging call logic to facilitate easy log message dispatching and chaining.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for logging, managing a chain of LogNode objects, and defining log level constants.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode at the head of the log chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will handle log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the current LogNode if set.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, optionally with an exception.
